t.E410.agn: In 2017 EFSA saw no need for a numerical acceptable daily intake (ADI) and found no safety concern for the general population.
t.E410.body: Locust bean gum is practically neither digested nor absorbed; it is largely fermented by bacteria in the large intestine.
t.E410.prod: Obtained by physical means from plant seeds or tree exudate (gum).
t.E410.pw.0: EFSA reported that it could not fully evaluate the safety of this substance in foods for special medical purposes for infants and young children with the available data.
t.E410.pw.1: EFSA reported that it could not fully evaluate the safety of this substance in foods for special medical purposes for infants and young children with the available data.
t.E410.regx.0: Re-evaluated; no numerical ADI needed. Data insufficient for foods for special medical purposes for infants.
t.E410.regx.1: Purity criteria updated (heavy metal limits lowered); from 18.08.2026.
t.E410.summary: A plant gum obtained from carob seeds. It thickens ice cream, cream cheese and sauces.
t.E410.what: Thickens and slows the growth of ice crystals.
